Subject: Re: Muliple Site single domain

Werner vd Merwe:
> If I understand you correctly, you assign each user that is at a
> remote branch with an alternate email address, and specify the
> postfix server for that domain in transport?

All servers receive mail for ervv@example.com, but they need to
know where each user's mailbox is, so the idea is to use aliases
that map ervv@example.com to user@servername.example.com.  This
aliasing happens without changing the addresses from/to/cc/etc.
message headers.

Once the alias is expanded, the mail is either delivered on the
server itself (servername.example.com is its own name) or forwarded
to the machine servername.example.com.

For consistency these aliases need to be shared among all the
servers that accept mail for user@example.com. Something like LDAP
or SQL would do the job.

The above works because the delivery is controlled by the envelope
sender address, not by information in the message header.

	Wietse
